Every Box Tells a Story

Lucas water pumps for passenger cars, light commercial and off-highway engines: belt and timing-belt driven mechanical pumps, and electric main and auxiliary coolant pumps. Search by Lucas number, OE number or vehicle, then check the drive, impeller and fitment before you order.

Choose your pump

Four groups by how the pump is driven. Pick one to see every part number in it.

Find a part

Type a Lucas number, an OE number, a vehicle make or a model. Spaces and dashes are ignored, so 161a029015 finds Toyota 161A0-29015. Combine words to narrow down, for example golf 1.4 tsi.

Pump type

Technical data

FieldMeaning
DriveHow the pump is driven: timing belt, V-ribbed (poly-V) accessory belt, V-belt, gear or timing chain. Electric pumps run from the vehicle's 12 V or 24 V supply.
Teeth / RibsTeeth on the timing-belt sprocket, or ribs on the poly-V pulley (shown as PK in descriptions, e.g. 6PK).
PulleyWhether the belt pulley or sprocket is supplied fitted to the pump, with its outside diameter where known.
ImpellerImpeller material, diameter and number of blades (B). Where the market offers the same OE pump with metal or plastic impellers, both are shown.
HousingWhether the pump comes with its own housing, and the housing material.
GasketWhether a gasket or seal ring is included in the box.
Electric pumpsFunction (main, auxiliary, parking-heater, battery or transmission cooling), voltage, connector pins and shape, control signal (PWM or LIN), rated power, hose diameter and weight.
Cross referenceAftermarket pumps listed against the same OE number. These are functional equivalents for search; check fitment before ordering.

Technical data is compiled from the OE numbers each Lucas part replaces and from aftermarket listings for those numbers; blank fields mean the value is not yet confirmed. Vehicle fitment for mechanical pumps is shown by make; electric pumps list individual models, engines and years. Always check the OE number before ordering. Specifications may change without notice.
